selected_priority: Restore broken company-intelligence/recruiter-strategy compatibility and ship a combined application execution queue using requirement score, fresh company fit, freshness, and hard-gap caps.
displaced_capability: Current main had two interacting losses: estate-intelligence tests could not even collect because parse_company_intelligence had disappeared from the modern company-intelligence module, and company-fit admission could disagree with recruiter-copy evidence mapping. Helix also lacked a batch execution surface that turned requirement and company-fit intelligence into a prioritized opening queue.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: Recover the displaced atlas parser contract and preserve the existing opportunity, company-fit, and recruiter-strategy APIs rather than replacing later code.
Build an independent batch scorer over normalized openings. This adds queueing but duplicates scoring semantics and leaves the broken compatibility path unresolved.

Restore the historical parser contract, strengthen company-signal evidence matching with conservative concept normalization, reuse that same matcher in recruiter projection, then compose opportunity score, fresh company fit, freshness, and hard-gap caps into one deterministic execution queue.

capabilities: batch-ranks real normalized openings into APPLY_NOW, APPLY_NEXT, PREPARE_GAPS, DEFER, and BLOCKED_PROOF lanes
uses explicit requirement coverage as the dominant job-fit signal while composing fresh provenance-bound company fit and freshness
hard-caps major requirement gaps at 45 and missing public-proof blockers at 20 so company alignment cannot rescue an unqualified opening

rejects company intelligence whose company_id does not match the target
restores parse_company_intelligence for the external bottleneck atlas without replacing the newer CompanyIntelligence model
normalizes conservative concept families such as agent/agents and engineered/engineering before company-evidence matching
shares the exact company-evidence matcher between company-fit admission and recruiter-copy projection so admitted signals cannot disappear downstream
preserves company-source URLs outside candidate claim_sources

preserved_gains: existing assess_opportunity scoring and explicit requirement-gap semantics remain intact
existing project_requirement_aware_application and project_company_aware_application interfaces remain intact
existing ApplicationStore and manual adapter lifecycle remain intact

invariants: fresh aligned opening outranks weaker opening
major hard gaps cannot be rescued by company alignment
stale intelligence contributes no freshness or fit
